title: Voice STT + background incoming calls
objective: Blyp home voice bar and push-to-describe return real transcripts instead of opaque failure. Incoming audio calls ring with full-screen notification when the app is backgrounded or killed. Audio STT uses Gemini first; on Gemini 429/quota/upstream failure, OpenAI Whisper (not chat image_url mapping).
acceptanceCriteria: geminiProxy routes audio/STT to Gemini first; on 429/quota/upstream failure uses OpenAI Whisper and returns Gemini-shaped JSON (never chat.completions image_url mapping of audio).
Android ships BlypCallMessagingService and call FCM is data-only high-priority so native IncomingCallModule can run when JS is dead.
Home voice / Review describe failure messages distinguish auth/quota/empty-audio instead of a single opaque phrase.
Play AAB is built from committed sources at a new versionCode after these fixes.

analysts.responsibility: Confirm voice STT and background-call requirements are observable and complete.

builders.responsibility: Implement STT routing and native FCM call wake path.

reviewers.responsibility: Read-only review that the claimed root causes are actually fixed in the candidate.
